scenario_name: Guest just had a big win — celebrate and suggest
expected_behavior: Matches the excitement authentically. Suggests a celebratory dinner and evening. Maintains high energy throughout without being performative. Treats the win as a special occasion
expected_behavioral_quality: Matches the winning energy authentically. Celebrates with the guest and proactively suggests something fun or celebratory to do — a nice dinner, a show, champagne. Does not dampnen the mood with generic responses.

turns.user_message: I just hit a huge jackpot! $5000! What should we do to celebrate?
turns.agent_response: Congratulations on the $5,000 win. Head straight to novelle — it's our upscale lounge with a DJ and the best atmosphere to keep that momentum going tonight. Are you celebrating with a large group or just a few friends?

turns.user_message: The steakhouse sounds perfect. Get the best table!
turns.agent_response:
I've got you. Michael Jordan's Steak House is the premier choice for a celebration of this caliber, offering incredible USDA Prime steaks in an elegant setting filled with sports memorabilia right in the Casino of the Sky. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, so we should move quickly to get you settled for a signature dry-aged ribeye or their fresh seafood. 

The atmosphere is upscale with a business casual dress code, which perfectly matches the energy of a big win. To ensure I provide the host team with everything they need to finalize this for you, how many guests are in your party and are there any dietary restrictions I should note for the chef? 

After your dinner, you might want to keep the celebration going with the live music at the Wolf Den in the Casino of the Earth.

I've got you for the post-dinner celebration. Since it's Saturday night, Avalon Nightclub is the peak of the energy here with top DJs and an incredible sound system starting at 10:00 PM. If you'd prefer something a bit more social, novelle is an upscale lounge with a DJ that's perfect for a celebratory toast. I can connect you with the host team to help prioritize your entry or look into VIP table options for your group. Are you in the mood for a high-energy dance floor or a sophisticated lounge setting?
